title: One Year at Boston College Now Costs $95,258. Stanford Just Froze Its Price.
description:
Boston College's cost of attendance for 2026-27 climbs to $95,258 (a 3.78% increase, with undergraduate tuition at $75,070) — while Stanford held its undergraduate tuition flat for the first time in a decade. Two very different answers to the same question: what is a college education actually worth?
